name: Seamline
summary: Tech news on a split screen: the product's real launch footage and demos in the top half, the speaker at the desk in the bottom half, two pixel-type caption words riding the seam between them. Hard cuts about every 1.3 s, short full-frame face inserts that push in slowly, a heavy sliding headline to open, a dark bed under the voice.
bestFor: launch and release news with the maker's own footage
"X just shipped Y" takes in 45 to 90 seconds
product demos with the speaker reacting
